name: coldcaller.pro
description: French B2B prospecting SaaS that sells qualified cold-calling leads to solopreneurs and agencies, enriched with the business owner's direct mobile and email, so you skip the receptionist (homepage tagline: "Plus de RDV en moins de temps, sans passer par la secrétaire"). €19 / €49 / €99 per month, no free trial. Founded Apr 2026, FR, one person, bootstrapped, word-of-mouth only. Listed for sale at $70,000 (0.4x; first listed Aug 4, 2026).

mentions.evidence: ~$3,309 MRR (−21.3% L30), 103 active subscriptions, ~$14,533 L30 (well above MRR, probably one-off lead packs or annual plans; my inference), ~$82,467 all-time, ~93% L30 profit margin, ~3,003 visitors in L30. Revenue synced Oct 7, 2026 ~07:42 Warsaw (05:42 UTC). The founder description says €2.4k MRR, which is older than the current Stripe figure.
mentions.indieAngle: Build it on public registries plus enrichment for one country: in PL, KRS/CEIDG board members + phone numbers for "właściciel firmy" by industry and city. Watch GDPR closely (B2B legitimate-interest rules differ by country), and sell to the agencies that dial all day.

whyItPrints: Data resale with almost no costs: 93% margin and ~9% visitor-to-paid conversion (founder-stated). Lead data on the people who sign the cheques is something SMB sellers always pay for.
